title: Memory-Efficient Integer-Only Training of Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.16298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training neural networks in reduced precision can yield significant efficiency gains, yet all existing methods that scale to standard computer vision benchmarks retain floating-point in at least one stage, typically the weight update or optimizer state. We present a training algorithm that scales to modern deep neural networks, in which every tensor (weights, gradients, and activations) is stored as INT8, and every operation (forward pass, backward pass, weight update, optimizer update) is performed in integer arithmetic. Specifically, tensors are stored as signed integer mantissas paired with explicit power-of-two exponents, on which integer-only operations are performed using five custom composable building blocks (products, sums, divide-by-constant, nonlinear functions, and weight updates). translated_title: 深度神经网络的内存高效纯整数训练
translated_abstract: 在降低精度下训练神经网络可以带来显著的效率提升，然而，所有现有的能够扩展到标准计算机视觉基准的方法都在至少一个阶段保留了浮点数，通常是在权重更新或优化器状态中。我们提出了一种可扩展到现代深度神经网络的训练算法，其中每个张量（权重、梯度和激活）都以 INT8 存储，每个操作（前向传播、反向传播、权重更新、优化器更新）都以整数算术执行。具体而言，张量以带符号整数尾数与显式的二的幂指数配对的形式存储，并使用五个自定义的可组合构建块（乘积、求和、除以常数、非线性函数和权重更新）在其上执行纯整数操作。这使得可以完整实现可训练的整数层，包括卷积、批归一化与层归一化、softmax 以及 GELU。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种完全基于INT8整数算术的深度神经网络训练算法，所有张量的存储和所有操作（包括前向传播、反向传播、权重更新及优化器更新）均完全摒弃浮点数，实现了可扩展到现代网络的内存高效纯整数训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an integer-only training algorithm for deep neural networks in which every tensor (weights, gradients, activations) is stored as INT8 and every operation, including weight and optimizer updates, is performed entirely in integer arithmetic, eliminating floating-point computation across all training stages for memory-efficient training.
